name: cursor
description: Cursor (unverified in a live session): reads AGENTS.md itself, hooks in .cursor/hooks.json (native mode) or Claude Code's .claude/ files (compat mode), skills in .cursor/skills, a deny-read block in .cursorignore.

entry-file.fills: none: Cursor reads AGENTS.md itself, nested files too, so the entry file must be AGENTS.md (`harness check scaffold`)

always-loaded-rules.fills: the entry file only; the preset writes no `.cursor/rules` file, which would load the rules a second time

on-demand-rules.fills: the reading map of the entry file

hook-configuration.fills: native: .cursor/hooks.json (version 1; sessionStart, beforeShellExecution, preToolUse on Write, afterFileEdit); compat (Claude Code is a selected runtime): none, Cursor runs the hooks of .claude/settings.json; the invariants are checked by `harness check scaffold`

hook-io.fills: tools/runtime-hooks/io.mjs: stdin JSON with hook_event_name and command or file_path (recognised by cursor_version); a block is exit code 2 and the JSON answer permission deny with agent_message; session context is the JSON field additional_context

read-exclusions.fills: a managed block of .cursorignore from access.denyRead, in both modes. It blocks the agent; terminal commands and MCP tools run outside it

procedure-packaging.fills: native: .cursor/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with name and description; disable-model-invocation for explicit procedures; generated by `harness sync`. Compat: none, Cursor loads .claude/skills

managed-blocks.fills: the deny-read block of .cursorignore, added at the end of the project's file by the sync when it is missing

hook-adoption.fills: native: adds the framework's hook entries to the project's own .cursor/hooks.json and names the hook commands that are not the framework's; compat: leaves the file as it is

enforces.by: native mode: `guard-shell` on `beforeShellExecution` refuses a commit on a protected branch
native mode: `guard-shell` on `beforeShellExecution` refuses a commit or a push on a protected branch
native mode: `guard-shell` on `beforeShellExecution` refuses a push to a protected branch
native mode: `guard-shell` on `beforeShellExecution` refuses `push --delete`, `push :branch` and the API call that deletes a ref
native mode: `guard-shell` refuses `gh pr merge --auto` into the production branch, on a release or hotfix branch and on a pull request not into the integration branch
native mode: `guard-shell` refuses `gh pr merge --auto` where `host.autoMerge` is off

native mode: `guard-edit` on `preToolUse` (Write) refuses the edit of an environment file; the `.cursorignore` block of `access.denyRead` keeps secrets out of the agent's reads (terminal commands and MCP tools are outside it); nothing scans the committed content for a secret
